children.text: Two panes: sessions master list (recents-first) on the left, the selected thing's detail on the right. Tap a session row = load it and return to the stage; the chevron = open detail without loading — browsing and loading are different gestures. Auto-save always, no per-session lock: Save and Save as… are deleted; the open session persists on its own, and no-session is the persisted Scratch slot — naming is Rename or Save a copy (the pre-gig insurance). Entry is the stage's status-bar session block only — no rail slot; the rail stays engine domains, so no rail item is lit here. Captures are grouped by session: a session's detail lists its takes (the arm-time snapshot records the session name), with the compact all-captures list for cross-session browsing. Recovered is a quiet collapsed group at the bottom — "kept 30 days" is the stated contract; Keep promotes a take to a normal capture under its session; an empty pool means no group at all. Desktop reuses these screens one-to-one and adds Export mixdown/stems to session detail and Show in Finder to capture detail. These four screens supersede SESSION & CAPTURE / sessions, which stays in place until the implementation lands, then retires. (#682)
